narr: A cold front moved into South Central Texas and generated thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced large hail and heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. An observer near Saint Hedwig reported 8.39 inches of rain in four hours. Several low water crossings in eastern Bexar County were closed due to flooding.
lsr: SEVERAL LOW WATER CROSSINGS ARE REPORTED FLOODED IN EASTERN BEXAR COUNTY. GROUND TRUTH REPORTS OF 4-6 OF RAINFALL OVER THE PAST 3 HOURS.
